family-lavender.purpose: The accent on pages outside any plugin; plugin pages replace it with the catalog accent.

family-lavender-low.purpose: Starlight's low accent tint for the family accent.

family-lavender-high.purpose: Starlight's high accent tint for the family accent.

attribute.purpose: Tooltip attribute lines: measured stats only.

tooltip-border-top.purpose: Top of the tooltip's 2px gradient border.

tooltip-border-bottom.purpose: Bottom of the tooltip's 2px gradient border.

tooltip-outline.purpose: The ring outside the tooltip border.

tooltip-ground.purpose: Near-black violet ground of item tooltips, asides and lore lists.

panel.purpose: Raised GUI surface: header, chest, buttons, pager, table header.

slot.purpose: Inset surface: item slots, search, inline code, current nav.

edge.purpose: 2px dark border round panels and buttons.

text.purpose: Body text, headings, resting links, keyboard-focus frame.

text-quiet.purpose: Starlight gray-2: switcher links at rest.

muted.purpose: Sidebar links at rest and mono labels.

lore.purpose: Tooltip lore, the lead, header nav at rest, table headers.

hint.purpose: Placeholders, hints and row labels (5.1:1 on the ground).

accentSource.rule: Per-plugin accents are never hand-typed. Pages of a plugin load public/accents/<id>.css (generated by docs/scripts/catalog.ts from xena-studios/brand tokens/plugins-catalog.json), which sets --accent and --sl-color-accent(-low/-high). Items on the home inventory read the catalog's accentText as --item; the horizon reads the brand accent.

display.purpose: The home page's one heading beside the inventory.

headline.purpose: A plugin overview's name, in its accent.

title.purpose: Every other page's h1; h2-h4 share weight and tracking.

item-name.purpose: Tooltip names, in the item's accent.

lead.purpose: The home pitch, in lore grey, 34ch.

body.purpose: The calm reading column at Starlight's measure.

stat.purpose: Attribute lines: measured facts in attribute blue.

label.purpose: Mono uppercase structural labels: sidebar groups, site label, aside titles, table headers, row labels.

shadows.name: bevel-raised

shadows.name: bevel-inset
shadows.purpose: Slots, search field, current header navigation.

shadows.name: bevel-button
shadows.purpose: GUI buttons at rest; primary mixes both from the accent at 55% with white and black.

shadows.name: bevel-pressed
shadows.purpose: A button while held, with translateY(2px).

shadows.name: ring-chosen
shadows.purpose: Added outside the inset bevel on the current sidebar page; the inventory uses a 2px outline in --item.

shadows.name: frame-focus
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on slots and buttons (2px offset on buttons).

shadows.name: tooltip-float
shadows.purpose: Item tooltips only: the one soft shadow.

shadows.name: tooltip-border
shadows.purpose: Tooltip, overview lore and aside border.

shadows.name: section-opener
shadows.purpose: Above each h2 in the reading column and under the overview product header.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one easing for every transition.

motion.name: button-hover
motion.purpose: Buttons brighten on hover (1.12-1.15 on pager, switcher, link buttons).

motion.name: link

motion.name: tooltip-follow

breakpoints.name: workbench

narrative.overview:
The family is a chest inventory in a deepslate game GUI. Every plugin is an item in a slot; pointing at it shows its tooltip, and the tooltip is the pitch, the stats and the Download. The same three materials frame every page: raised panels with a 2px pixel bevel, slots that are the same bevel inverted, and the near-black violet item tooltip with its violet-to-indigo border. The header, navigation, page titles, panels, code and tables are built from them.

Inside that frame, reading stays calm. Commands, configuration, guides and changelogs keep a plain column of Space Grotesk on deepslate, so the GUI is the frame, not the reading surface. Colour is held back: the ground is a tight family of violet-tinted near-blacks, and the only saturated colour on a page is the accent of the plugin it belongs to (or the family's pale lavender elsewhere), on three things only.

Everything that lists the plugins (slots, rows, the horizon's rim, accents) is generated from the brand catalog, so a new plugin takes its place in the GUI without a hand edit. The site is dark only.
keyCharacteristics: Square corners and a 2px pixel bevel: light top-left, dark bottom-right on panels, inverted on slots.
The item tooltip as the selling and handover surface: name in the item's accent, lore in grey, stats as blue attribute lines.
One accent per page, from the catalog, on a name, the chosen slot and the primary action.
A calm reading column inside the GUI frame.
Pixel-crisp 16px glyphs scaled in slots; a stepped pixel horizon whose rim is shared by every plugin.

rules.name: The Three Places Rule
rules.body: The accent appears only on a name (the plugin's or item's name), the chosen slot and the primary action. Links are text colour with a quiet underline and take the accent only on hover.

rules.name: The Catalog Owns the Accent Rule
rules.body: Accents come from the brand catalog, per plugin, and are never hand-typed. A surface needing a plugin's colour reads `--sl-color-accent` (the page's plugin) or the catalog's `accentText` (another plugin's item); a new plugin's colour arrives through `scripts/catalog.ts`, not through CSS.

rules.name: The White Frame Rule
rules.body: The chosen slot is framed in the plugin's accent (2px); a 2px frame in `text` marks keyboard focus. Selection and focus never share a colour.

rules.name: The Mono Is a Readout Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono sets measured facts (versions, sizes, platforms) and short structural labels. It never sets a sentence, a headline or decoration.

rules.name: The Bold Name Rule
rules.body: Names are Space Grotesk Bold with negative tracking (-0.01em to -0.035em, tighter as size grows). Nothing else on the page is set larger than the name it belongs to.

rules.name: The Calm Column Rule
rules.body: Reading pages keep a calm column inside the GUI frame: plain text on deepslate at Starlight's measure. GUI material goes on the frame, code, tables, asides and section openers, never behind running prose.

rules.name: The Selling Pages Rule
rules.body: Home, overview and download pages have no contents column, pager or edit line. They sell or hand over the plugin; they are not reading pages.

rules.name: The Two-Pixel Bevel Rule
rules.body: Every raised or inset surface uses the 2px bevel (`--gui-px`), light top-left and dark bottom-right, inverted for slots. Hard-edged inset shadows are this world's native material; blurred shadows are not.

rules.name: The Only Lift Rule
rules.body: The item tooltip is the only element with a soft drop shadow. Panels, slots and buttons stay in the GUI plane.

rules.name: The Five Lore Lines Rule
rules.body: An overview's opening lore list has at most five lines. More features belong in the page below it, not in the tooltip.

rules.name: The Rim Belongs to the Catalog Rule
rules.body: The horizon is drawn from the catalog, each plugin owning a stretch of the rim. It is never a static image or a hand-picked set of colours.

dos: Do take every plugin colour from the brand catalog (`accentText` in `src/data/plugins.json`, or `--sl-color-accent` on that plugin's pages).
Do keep the accent to a name, the chosen slot and the primary action; links rest in `text` and show the accent on hover.
Do frame the chosen slot in the plugin's accent and mark keyboard focus with a 2px `text` frame.
Do build frames from the three materials: raised panel, inset slot, item tooltip, all square with the 2px bevel.
Do keep reading pages to a calm column inside the GUI frame.
Do drop the contents column, pager and edit line on home, overview and download pages.
Do open each overview with at most five lore lines in tooltip material.
Do set stats in mono `attribute` with tabular figures, and only stats that the build or Modrinth can back.
Do render glyphs pixelated at a whole-slot scale.
donts: Don't hand-type a plugin's hex value in CSS or a component.
Don't put the accent on body links at rest, headings, borders or backgrounds beyond the three places.
Don't round the corners of panels, slots, buttons, tooltips or code.
Don't give panels, slots or buttons a blurred drop shadow; the tooltip is the only thing that floats.
Don't put GUI panels or tooltip material behind running prose on reading pages.
Don't draw the horizon from a fixed image or a hand-picked palette.
Don't use JetBrains Mono for sentences or headlines.
